subject: Pricing exception request: Lighthouse University — edu/nonprofit baseline rate
messages:
From: Ana Torres <ana.torres@lighthouse.edu>
To: dylan_brooks@redwood.com
Date: 2025-08-12T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Inquiry: education discount & baseline pricing for research cluster

Hi Dylan,

Lighthouse University is preparing a 6‑month research cluster for an interdisciplinary AI lab and we're evaluating hosted inference vendors. We like Redwood's performance profile but have to work within a constrained education budget. Two quick questions: 1) Do you have an education / nonprofit pricing band for the hosted API (baseline per-token rates)? 2) Is Redwood able to make a one-off baseline-rate exception for academic research projects (no enterprise billing, low commit)?

I've attached a short university affiliation letter and a procurement contact (Dr. Samuel Reed). If helpful, we can share projected monthly token volume (~200M tokens) and peak concurrency requirements.

Thanks — Ana
Ana Torres
Director of Research Operations
Lighthouse University
Attachment: lighthouse_proof_of_affiliation.pdf
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
To: Ana Torres <ana.torres@lighthouse.edu>
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: 2025-08-13T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Inquiry: education discount & baseline pricing for research cluster

Hi Ana — great to meet you over email. Thanks for the affiliation letter — that helps. Short answers up front: yes, we offer an education/nonprofit program and we can consider a temporary baseline-rate exception for research projects, but it depends on expected usage and a short commitment (3–6 months) so we can provide predictable capacity.

What I need from you to propose a concrete exception:
- Confirm projected average monthly tokens and expected peak QPS/concurrency
- Confirm whether the university will sign a short MSA or a PO (DocuSign works)
- Any compliance requirements (data residency, retention) that would affect hosting

I'm attaching our current rate card for hosted API (redwood_rate_card_v2.pdf) — the edu program typically gets a 20–30% discount off list for qualifying cases; exceptions below that range are possible but require manager approval.

If you're available I can also schedule a 30m call this week to walk options and tradeoffs (burst capacity, caching, quantization). Monica (cc'd) will handle onboarding and billing details.

Best,
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Phone: (415) 555-0183
Attachment: redwood_rate_card_v2.pdf
From: Ana Torres <ana.torres@lighthouse.edu>
To: dylan_brooks@redwood.com
Cc: Dr. Samuel Reed <s.reed@lighthouse.edu>
Date: 2025-08-13T14:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Inquiry: education discount & baseline pricing for research cluster

Thanks, Dylan — attaching a short volume estimate and the procurement contact's details. The core PhD lab expects ~200M tokens/month while the full program (multiple labs) could be 450–600M/month after month two. Peak concurrency needs are modest (50–100 req/s), but low latency is important for researcher workflows.

Procurement preference: PO to Redwood with a short MSA addendum. No special residency needs — US hosting is fine.

I'll hold a 30min slot on Thursday if you send a calendar invite.

Regards,
Ana
Attachment: lighthouse_volume_estimate.xlsx

Marissa — can you review for approval? Lighthouse University (external) is asking for a reduced baseline rate for a research cluster. Details: initial program ~200M tokens/mo, potential to scale to ~500M/mo. They prefer PO + short MSA. They provided proof of affiliation. I attached the rate card.

Proposed exception (my recommendation): 35% off list baseline for first 3 months (hosted API), with the following conditions: 1) PO or signed DocuSign MSA within 14 days; 2) Redwood right to revert to standard rate after trial unless a committed reserved capacity agreement is executed; 3) Redwood billing to bill monthly in arrears. This is slightly deeper than typical education band to accommodate research grants with limited runway.

If approved, Monica can present onboarding timeline and the DocuSign link.

— Dylan
